pieces.Text: As a standard action, you can cause a victim within 30 ft. who can see you to be fascinated (Will save DC

, +2 if wielding two sawtooth sabres). The fascination effect is a mind-affecting effect. After 3 rounds of concentrating, you can make a coup de grace attack against your victim; the Red Mantis assassin maintains this fascination effect while delivering a coup de grace.
